prompt:
Decide whether this exchange contains a strawman.

Structure: one person makes Claim A. A DIFFERENT person replies with Claim B.

Label STRAWMAN if Claim B misrepresents Claim A as a different, stronger or more extreme position than the one actually stated, and argues against that distorted version.
Label NONE if Claim B fairly paraphrases Claim A, asks a genuine clarifying question (even a pointed one), or disagrees with what Claim A actually says.

Claim A: [Content note: sexual violence] Only a tiny percentage of people (regardless of gender) have the psychological propensity to rape; that percentage will keep offending regardless of culture, so people looking for 'rape culture' evidence will always find some.

Claim B: I think the majority of people are psychologically capable of rape under the right conditions (e.g. soldiers in wartime). If what you're saying is true, rape rates wouldn't be affected by culture.

Respond with exactly this JSON: {"label": "STRAWMAN" or "NONE", "reason": "<one sentence>"}
